name: personalized-travel-itinerary-planner
description: Personalized travel itinerary planner with vibe-based recommendations.

scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => { try { fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'dist/404.html'); } catch {} })"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c teal,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
